title: HR Data Analyst - CDI (F/H/X)
description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.
 

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Rattaché(e) à la Directrice Compensation & Benefits Groupe au sein de la Direction des Ressources Humaines, vos missions principales seront de :

🎯 MISSIONS

  • Élaborer la production de rapports légaux tels que Bilan social, supports de NAO, rapport d’égalité H/F et index égalité H/F, rapport RSE, BDES, etc. 

  • Préparer, en lien avec la Direction des Relations Sociales, diverses présentations à l’attention des représentants du personnel ;

  • Produire et  suivre les différents rapports et KPIs appuyant directement la stratégie RH, tels que les rapports effectifs mensuels, l’analyse du turnover, de l’absentéisme, etc. Il sera de votre responsabilité de donner un sens aux données ;

  • Elaborer et produire les enquêtes trimestrielles et annuelles (ACEMO, ECMOSS, PIPA, BMO) ;

  • Gérer  la cohérence des données RH du Système d’Information Monde (WORKDAY).

  • Assurer la transition vers des solutions intégrants l’IA pour produire ces data

  • Être force de proposition pour le développement de nouveaux indicateurs et la production de nouveaux formats de reporting.

 

Vous participerez, en relation avec l’Équipe SIRH, à l’amélioration continue des processus d’intégration et de contrôle de l’information.

👉 PRÉ REQUIS

  • De formation supérieure, Ecole RH / Finance, de Commerce ou équivalent,

  • Vous avez au moins 2 ans d’expérience en reporting RH ou contrôle de gestion social.

  • Vous êtes capable de prendre du recul, d’analyser et de synthétiser un flux important de données. 

  • Vous avez une vraie sensibilité pour les problématiques RH et le sens de la confidentialité. 

  • Curieux(se), motivé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous avez le sens des priorités, vous êtes force de proposition et orienté(e) solutions. 

  • Vous avez envie d’évoluer dans un environnement complexe et exigeant, rempli de défis et d’opportunités à saisir.

  • Vous maîtrisez très bien Excel (fonctions avancées, TCD, graphiques)

  • Vous avez un appétence affirmée pour l’IA et avez l’envie de vous perfectionner

  • La maîtrise opérationnelle de la langue anglaise est indispensable.

✅ AVANTAGES

  • 👉 Prime variable 
  • 👉 Participation aux bénéfices et plan d'intéressement 
  • 👉 Bureau flexible avec au minimum 2 jours sur place et jusqu'à 3 jours à domicile
  • 👉 Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne
  • 👉 Comité d’entreprise CE
  • 👉 Mutuelle

⚙️PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

  • ▶️ Premier entretien téléphonique avec un recruteur pour échanger sur votre compréhension du poste, votre expérience, vos motivations personnelles et professionnelles ainsi que vos valeurs. 
  • ▶️ Echange en visioconférence avec votre futur manager pour approfondir les échanges sur vos connaissances et motivations.
 
Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes reconnues en situation de handicap.
 
Nous sommes convaincus que c'est à vous de définir votre façon de travailler, de vous développer et de progresser. Chez Veepee, nous vous garantissons que vous pouvez tout simplement être vous-même ! Au service de la diversité et de l'inclusion, Veepee s'engage à examiner toutes les candidatures reçues sur une base égalitaire.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
About HiredBuddy

At HiredBuddy, we connect domain specialists and subject-matter experts with leading AI research labs to shape and train the next generation of artificial intelligence. We focus on high-quality data annotation, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), and model evaluation across various domains, ranging from STEM and software engineering to linguistics and data science.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Junior Data Analyst based in the United States to join our growing remote team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in monitoring dataset quality, analyzing annotator performance metrics, optimizing labeling pipelines, and delivering insights that improve our AI training data pipelines.

This is an ideal role for an early-career analyst passionate about the intersection of data, machine learning, and AI operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Quality Assurance: Audit, clean, and validate large datasets generated by our network of AI trainers and domain experts to ensure high precision and adherence to guidelines.
  • Performance & Metrics Tracking: Analyze annotator accuracy, turnaround times, and throughput using SQL, Python, and BI dashboards to help optimize operations.
  • Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, AI Specialists, and Product) to identify bottlenecks in data labeling pipelines and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build, maintain, and update daily/weekly operational reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders and client leads.
  • Guideline Calibration: Analyze edge cases and error patterns in dataset outputs to help refine project annotation instructions and rubrics.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelorâs degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency with SQL for data querying, aggregation, and analysis.
  • Practical knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas).
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a high degree of attention to detail when working with complex datasets.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly translate data findings into actionable insights for non-technical team members.
  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, data annotation workflows, or RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback).
  • Prior experience or internship experience in an operations-focused analyst role.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • Cutting-Edge Industry Exposure: Gain hands-on experience at the forefront of AI model training and evaluation.
  • Growth Opportunities: Direct mentorship and opportunities to advance within a fast-growing tech environment.
  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly/Salaried rate commensurate with experience.

title: Operations Associate
description:
About Airspeed

Airspeed is AI revenue execution. We connect signals across CRM, calls, Slack, and product systems. Our agents flag deal risk early and help teams act. They coach reps, manage follow-ups, update the CRM, and identify likely slips.


Founded by former DeepMind researchers, Airspeed now supports hundreds of revenue teams, including Persona, Menlo Security, Pricefx, and Wayflyer. We are a Series A company with approximately 40 people across London, New York, San Francisco, and Boston.

The Opportunity

We are hiring an Operations Associate to serve as a critical operational backbone for our fast-growing GTM team and manage our central London hub.


This is a dynamic, multi-faceted role for a proactive problem-solver who enjoys working across data, technology, project management, and day-to-day office operations. You will sit at the intersection of revenue operations, business operations, and local team enablement—ensuring our GTM processes run cleanly while maintaining a great working environment in our UK office.
You will work closely with our VP of GTM Strategy & Operations and cross-functional leaders, gaining direct exposure to how a high-growth AI company scales its commercial engine and internal infrastructure.

What You Will Own

GTM & Revenue Operations Support:

  • Data Quality & Hygiene: Maintain high data integrity by executing data cleaning and deduplication across multiple platforms, including Clay and HubSpot.

  • Front-Line Tech Support: Serve as the primary Slack support contact for our GTM team, troubleshooting day-to-day tech issues and tool workflows.

  • Special Projects: Partner directly with the VP of GTM Strategy & Operations on high-priority initiatives across business operations, finance operations, revenue operations, and ad-hoc commercial tasks.

Project Management & Execution:

  • Keep cross-functional projects on track by coordinating stakeholder teams, monitoring milestones, and ensuring clear communication across dependencies.

  • Document lightweight operational processes to help the team scale efficiently.

London Office Management:

  • Own the day-to-day operations of the UK office in London, ensuring the space is always fully stocked, organized, well-maintained, and set up for team success.

  • Coordinate local vendor relationships, supplies, and office logistics to foster an inviting, productive workplace.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first several quarters:

  • Our CRM and GTM platforms (HubSpot, Clay) maintain a high bar of data accuracy and cleanliness.

  • Day-to-day GTM tool issues are resolved quickly on Slack, keeping revenue reps focused on selling.

  • Cross-functional projects driven by GTM Strategy & Operations land on time with clear stakeholder alignment.

  • The London office runs seamlessly as a functional, vibrant hub for the local team and visiting colleagues.

What We Are Looking For

  • Operational Drive: Proven ability to manage multiple distinct workstreams—from data tasks to office logistics—with high attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Tech-Savvy & Adaptable: Comfort working with or learning GTM tools. Direct experience with Clay, HubSpot, Airspeed, Nooks, or Alguna is a plus, but not required—we will train you up on all these platforms.

  • Data Hygiene Mindset: Systematic approach to organizing, cleaning, and verifying data across different software platforms.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: Strong communication skills with the ability to keep project teams aligned, accountable, and moving forward.

  • Problem-Solving Orientation: A helpful, service-oriented attitude when supporting colleagues via Slack or resolving office challenges.

  • Builder Mindset: High ownership and flexibility to adapt as priorities shift in a fast-paced Series A environment.

Why Join Airspeed

  • Gain broad, hands-on exposure to strategy, finance, and revenue operations in a fast-scaling AI business.

  • Work directly with senior leadership, including the VP of GTM Strategy & Operations.

  • Enjoy a high-visibility role where your work directly impacts team productivity and office culture.

  • Master modern GTM tools and AI-native operational workflows.

  • Join an international SaaS company at an exciting stage of growth.

How to Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile together with a short note sharing an example of an operational challenge or project you successfully managed. Tell us what the issue was, how you handled it, and the outcome.
